subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are writing to confirm your upcoming flight booking from New York to London on September 15, 2021. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 10:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please make sure to arrive at least two hours prior to the departure time for check-in. Should you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, please don't hesitate to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, Airline Customer Service
